title: Event chat contract
description: Language-neutral event chat shapes shared by iOS, Android, backend, and admin. chatMessage mirrors the Firestore `events/{eventId}/messages/{messageId}` document (docs/firebase-data-model.md); messages are written only via the events.postChatMessage callable and moderated via the events.removeChatMessage / events.allowChatMessage callables and the events-onMessageReportCreate auto-hide trigger. Moderation is a state machine: visible → auto_hidden (trigger, once several DISTINCT users report the message) and the terminal admin overrides removed and allowed. auto_hidden PRESERVES the body (clients show a collapsed 'Show reported message' placeholder with per-user ephemeral reveal); removed has an empty body (a permanent moderator-removed placeholder, no reveal) with the original text only in the admin audit record; allowed restores visibility and is never auto-hidden again. Firestore stores timestamps as native Timestamp values; this contract describes their ISO 8601 JSON serialization.

chatMessageModerationState.description: Moderation state machine. visible: normal. auto_hidden: hidden after >= CHAT_AUTO_HIDE_REPORTER_THRESHOLD distinct reporters (body preserved; reveal control). removed: tombstoned, empty body, permanent placeholder. allowed: admin-cleared, visible again, never auto-hidden again. Only the trigger's visible → auto_hidden transition is automatic; allowed/removed are terminal admin overrides.

chatMessageReportStatus.description: Moderation queue state for a report. events.removeChatMessage resolves open reports.

chatMessage.description: Firestore `events/{eventId}/messages/{messageId}`. Readable by active members with a going/maybe RSVP while the event is published; written only by the backend.

authorDisplayName.description: Denormalized at post time — avoids a users/{uid} read per rendered message.

message.description: Plain text. Empty string when moderationState is 'removed' (auto_hidden and allowed preserve the body).

hiddenAt.description: When the auto-hide trigger hid the message; null unless it was ever auto_hidden.

reportCount.description: Distinct-reporter tally recorded at auto-hide time; 0 until auto-hidden.

allowedAt.description: When an admin allowed (un-hid) the message; null unless allowed.

allowedByUserId.description: Admin UID who allowed the message, null unless allowed.

removedByUserId.description: Moderating admin UID, null unless removed.

chatMessageReport.description: Firestore `events/{eventId}/messageReports/{reportId}`. Never client-readable; reporter identities stay private. Document ID is deterministic per (message, reporter, reason) so repeat reports upsert silently.

postChatMessageRequest.description: Input for events.postChatMessage. Rate limited to ~5 messages per 30 seconds per user.

reportChatMessageRequest.description: Input for events.reportChatMessage. Own messages cannot be reported.

removeChatMessageRequest.description: Input for events.removeChatMessage (admin). Reason is required and lives in the audit record only — never in the member-readable message document.

allowChatMessageRequest.description: Input for events.allowChatMessage (admin). Un-hides an auto_hidden (or visible) message and marks it allowed (terminal, never auto-hidden again). No reason needed — allowing is benign; the audit record captures who and when.
